rationale: Round-5 final confirmation at reviewed commit 44e6cf2fa79b7d3d83cbdf31c5a03fdfe330981a. `git show 44e6cf2f --stat` and full-diff inspection verify exact confinement to three files and the disclosed 14 insertions/43 deletions: internal/panel/gate.go changes one decision-table label from the retired CommitAll name to the accurate materialize-past-review description; internal/complete/panel_advisory.go rewords only the panelGate doc comment while preserving its load-bearing stale-SHA and dirty-tree ordering rationale; internal/complete/complete.go only deletes the 31-line residualDirtyPaths helper. An independent revision grep finds residualDirtyPaths only at its definition in the parent and nowhere at 44e6cf2f. The disclosed CompleteBead `msg != ""` branch is appropriately deferred: the only production call site is internal/complete/complete.go and it passes the literal empty string after bead 6 moved materialization upstream, so the branch is unreachable in the delivered production flow and cannot bypass the reviewed gate. Removing it cleanly is a broader Executor-interface, mock, wrapper, test, and documentation migration rather than a necessary correction to this narrowly dispatched round-4 fix. It should remain visible as follow-up cleanup, but it does not undermine the protocol or the implementation previously approved. My standing verdict remains APPROVE.

findings.title: Round-4 corrective commit is exactly confined
findings.evidence: git diff-tree at 44e6cf2f reports only internal/complete/complete.go (0 insertions, 31 deletions), internal/complete/panel_advisory.go (13 insertions, 11 deletions), and internal/panel/gate.go (1 insertion, 1 deletion). The two modified hunks outside the helper deletion are comments/labels only; no executable statement, interface, test, fixture, or protocol artifact changed.
findings.impact: The requested twin-site honesty fixes landed without disturbing the previously approved behavior.

findings.title: Dormant CompleteBead auto-commit branch is valid follow-up work
findings.evidence: A production-only git grep at 44e6cf2f finds one CompleteBead invocation, internal/complete/complete.go:1099, and it passes msg as the literal empty string. The remaining matches are the Executor declaration and implementations. Therefore the msg-nonempty branch is not reachable from the current production workflow; deleting it properly would fan out across the shared interface and its implementations/wrappers.
findings.impact: No present bead-6 gate bypass exists. The dead capability should be removed in a separately scoped cleanup bead to reduce future misuse risk.
